_comment: Shared chord-naming vocabulary pin: pcs are pitch classes relative to the root. 'agreed' must produce identical sets from BOTH harmony.py (_symbol_to_intervals via parse_symbol) and chord-symbol (the QA tool's JS validator). 'divergent' pins each side's CURRENT deliberate behavior so silent drift on either side fails a test. Asserted by tests/test_chord_name_parity.py (Python) and tests/js/chord_naming_parity.test.js (JS).

divergent.note: harmony.py treats bare m9 as add9 — the corpus always writes the 7th explicitly (m7/9)
chord-symbol's 13 implies the 9th; harmony.py's does not (corpus writes 13,9 when both sound)
chord-symbol folds b13 into #5 and drops the natural 5; harmony.py keeps the 5th alongside
chord-symbol's 11 implies the 9th and omits the 3rd; harmony.py keeps the 3rd, no 9th
